Ali gets the flag at Khaybar, is nicknamed Abu Turab and is to the Prophet as Aaron to Moses; he and Fatima are taught bedtime glorifications instead of a servant.
The Prophet sends Ali to Yemen in Khalid's place, and tells Buraida, who hated Ali and faulted his taking a slave-girl from the fifth, that Ali deserves more than that.
The Prophet said Banu Al-Mughira had asked his leave to let Ali marry their daughter, and he gave no leave.
Ali loved the name Abu Turab, first given by the Prophet when he found him, angry with Fatima, sleeping by the mosque wall, and wiped dust from his back.
Finding Ali asleep and dusty in the mosque after a quarrel with Fatima, the Prophet wiped him and called him Abu Turab, the name Ali loved most.
